stories.title: Why Micah Parsons' ACL recovery is taking longer than Patrick Mahomes'
stories.summary: They were injured the same day, but while Mahomes was ready for Week 1, Parsons has yet to practice.

stories.title: Panthers' consistency starts in the trenches, rests with DC Ejiro Evero
stories.summary: From offensive line woes to a troubled run defense, Carolina (3-3) faces its problems entering Thursday night's game at Green Bay.

stories.title: 'Locked in' Gray, Dream hold off Valkyries, force first Finals Game 7
stories.summary: Allisha Gray scored 23 points as the Dream held off a late rally for an 80-69 victory over the Valkyries to force a historic Game 7 of the WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Red Wings suspend star forward Larkin as team explores trade options
stories.summary: The Detroit Red Wings announced Thursday that star forward Dylan Larkin has been suspended without pay after informing the team he no longer wanted to play for them.

stories.title: Longtime football coach Jones, pioneer of run-and-shoot offense, dies at 73
stories.summary: Longtime college and pro football coach June Jones, who helped popularize the run-and-shoot offense, has died at 73.
